notes.title: Star-Pit Starship V1.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Made controller/key input on ship designer much smoother. Buttery smooth even.
[*]Added Steam screenshot functionality (press F12). Would have had this on day 1 if I knew I had to code it. Oops!
[*]You can now buy your most recently designed ship in the ship designer if you have enough Graps to afford it (press P on keyboard, or R3 on gamepad). Note: this will reset when you reboot the game, so ships will not carry over between game sessions after quitting out.
[*]Reduced the enemy escape radius so when they go to a lower depth (become invulnerable) they will return sooner so you can continue attacking.
[*]Gave the sound effect for the player ship lasers a bit more oomph!
[*]Realized some achievements for Single Round High Scores were not configured correctly on the Steam side of things—that’s my fault. They should unlock now as it will check against your lifetime hi-score to see if you ever hit the threshold previously.
[/list]

I really appreciate the feedback I've been getting on the game so far. I consider all player input when updating the game, so please don't hesitate to let me know if there's a change you'd like to see made to the game. Sometimes I'm not able to make the changes, but I do take all feedback seriously. So thank you. And if you've been enjoying the game, please consider leaving a quick review on the store page--it helps out immensely.

- Matthew Milson
[url=http://puddledockgames.com/]Puddledock Games[/url]
